title: Eveque - Act 1 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Eveque in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 1, Spring Meadows.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Eveque is the first boss of Act 1 and the game's introduction to shields, elemental weakness and summoned adds. It is a teaching fight, but its shielded opening still stops players who ignore the mechanic.

sections.title: Where to Find the Eveque
sections.content: Location: Spring Meadows, Act 1. It also returns in The Monolith later in the game.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances

Ice is Eveque's weakness. Its own attack profile leans on Ice as well, so the fight is a mirror match in effect - you are both using the same element, which makes resist gear a reasonable swap.

sections.title: How to Beat the Eveque
sections.content:
Shields, not health

Eveque has multiple shield instances covering its body. Its weak point is exposed in the centre of the robe, which is the only place your damage really lands. Multi-hit skills strip shields faster than single heavy attacks.

It summons

Eveque can call two Abbests into the fight. If you leave them alive they add chip damage across the whole encounter, so clear them before you go back to the boss.

  • Ice is the weakness.
  • Aim at the exposed centre, not the robe itself.
  • Kill the summoned Abbests rather than tanking them.
